{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Desserts]]

'''Nanaimo Bars''' are a layered chocolate and [[Cookbook:Custard|custard]] dessert named after the mining town, Nanaimo, British Columbia, Canada. This winning recipe was submitted by Joyce Hardcastle in 1986 when the City of Nanaimo and Harbour Park Mall had a contest to find the best Nanaimo Bar recipe. Variations of this recipe include using different nuts and/or adding flavours to the custard layer.

== Ingredients ==

=== Bottom layer ===
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] unsalted [[Cookbook:butter|butter]] (European style cultured)
* ¼ cup white granulated [[Cookbook:sugar|sugar]]
* 5 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:cocoa|cocoa]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:egg|egg]] beaten
* 1¼ cups [[Cookbook:Graham Cracker|graham wafer]] crumbs
* ½ cups finely-[[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:almond|almonds]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:coconut|coconut]]

=== Middle layer ===
* ½ cup unsalted [[Cookbook:butter|butter]]
* 2 tbsp and 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:cream|cream]]
* 2 tbsp vanilla [[Cookbook:Custard Powder|custard powder]]
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|icing sugar]]

=== Top layer ===
* 4 squares (4 oz) semi-sweet [[Cookbook:chocolate|chocolate]]
* 2 tbsp unsalted [[Cookbook:butter|butter]]

== Procedure ==

=== Bottom layer ===
#Melt first 3 ingredients in top of [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]].
#Add egg and stir to cook and thicken.
#Remove from heat. Stir in crumbs, coconut, and nuts.
#Press firmly into an ungreased 8 x 8-inch [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pan]].

=== Middle layer ===
#[[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] butter, cream, custard powder, and icing sugar together well. [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] until light. 
#Spread over bottom layer.

=== Top layer ===
#Melt chocolate and butter over low heat. Cool. 
#Once cool, but still liquid, pour over second layer and chill in refrigerator.
#Once set, cut into squares and serve. Enjoy.
